name: google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physics_planning_games/mujoban/AGENT.python.tools.md

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.create_boxoban_instance: create a Boxoban instance to load and cache Boxoban puzzle levels from a dataset
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.generate_random_levels: use boxoban_level_generator to yield random Boxoban levels from the unfiltered valid set
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.download_and_cache_levels: call get_data on a Boxoban instance to download extract and cache levels as npz
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.access_loaded_levels: access the levels attribute on a Boxoban instance to get the numpy array of level strings
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.check_num_levels: check the num_levels attribute on a Boxoban instance to get the total number of loaded levels

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.create_mujoban_task: create a Mujoban task instance with a walker, maze, and configurable box and target rewards
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.initialize_episode_mjcf: initialize the MuJoCo scene with target pads, boxes, grid pegs, and contact pairs for an episode
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.initialize_episode: position the walker, boxes, and targets at their starting locations for a new episode
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.get_reward: compute the reward based on boxes entering or leaving targets and level completion
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.update_entity_pixel_layers: update the pixel layer and full entity layer grid representations from current physics state

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.create_mujoban_level: create a MujobanLevel instance from a Sokoban ASCII art level string using single_level_generator
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.regenerate_maze: regenerate the MujobanLevel maze by calling the regenerate method to load the next level from the generator
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.convert_ascii_to_text_grid: convert a Sokoban ASCII art level string to a Mujoban text grid format using _ascii_to_text_grid_level
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.get_level_dimensions: get the height and width properties of a MujobanLevel instance to retrieve the maze grid dimensions
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.query_boxes_and_targets: query the num_boxes and num_targets properties of a MujobanLevel to get box and target counts

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/physic.test_ascii_to_text_grid_level: test the MujobanLevelTest class to verify ascii level string converts to text grid format
